reviews.text: John and crew did a wonderful job lining our old wonky chimney. There was a lot of work involved and they did professional job and cleaned up after themselves. From start to finish they were kind, informative & committed to quality work.
reviews.author: Merrill L.

reviews.text: I had an emergency need for a chimney liner. I called him, and he came within 30 minutes, examined my chimney, and gave me an estimate. His crew came the next morning and finished the job before noon. They also cleaned up prior to leaving.
